summary: Read several coin denominations and one target amount. Each denomination may be selected any number of times, including zero times. Find the smallest number of coins that add up exactly to the target, and write that number of coins. If no selection adds up exactly to the target, write -1. Every denomination is a positive integer. There is no upper bound on how often a denomination is selected.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count, that many integers, and one target integer.
